title: PaperManager
description: A desktop library for research papers: every PDF filed once under a meaningful name, identified by NASA ADS, DOI or arXiv, tagged, full-text searchable, and verifiable against its own records. Includes a PDF reader with annotations, references and citations from ADS, publisher-PDF replacement for arXiv copies, an inbox for new downloads, BibTeX export and manuscript bibliographies.
